properties.rationale: Two instruction gaps from bhome S3 and flo2 F10 (2026-09-18), taken in Anthony's 'work your way through them one by one' (2026-09-19). Both mechanisms already existed; what was missing was the sentence that says so (three-legs rule: typed tool + instruction + detector) and, for the refusal, the one fact only the server holds — which fields this call passed.
